impact.en: Dry conditions and high fire risk in grasslands, bush and forests
impact.sw: Hali ya ukavu na hatari kubwa ya moto kwenye nyasi, vichaka na misitu

en: Do not burn farms, grass or rubbish without permission from Village/Mtaa leaders.
Report any fire to Village/Mtaa leaders or call 114.
Follow forecasts from the Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA).
sw: Usichome mashamba, nyasi wala taka bila kibali cha viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Toa taarifa ya moto wowote kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa au piga 114.
Fuatilia utabiri wa Mamlaka ya Hali ya Hewa Tanzania (TMA).

impact.en: Small fires starting from cooking, cigarettes or charcoal kilns
impact.sw: Moto mdogo kuanzishwa na mioto ya kupikia, sigara au matanuru ya mkaa

en: Put out cooking fires completely before leaving.
Do not throw cigarettes on dry grass.
Charcoal makers: never leave kilns unattended; clear the ground around them.
sw: Zima kabisa moto wa kupikia kabla ya kuondoka.
Usitupe sigara kwenye nyasi kavu.
Watengenezaji wa mkaa: msiache matanuru bila uangalizi; safisheni eneo linalozunguka.

impact.en: Smoke from nearby fires affecting air quality
impact.sw: Moshi kutoka mioto ya karibu kuathiri ubora wa hewa

en: Close doors and windows during heavy smoke.
People with asthma or chest conditions: stay indoors.
sw: Funga milango na madirisha wakati wa moshi mzito.
Watu wenye pumu au matatizo ya kifua: bakini ndani.

impact.en: Risk of fire spreading to pastures, farms and homes
impact.sw: Hatari ya moto kusambaa kwenye malisho, mashamba na makazi

en: Clear dry grass around homes, farms and grain stores.
Make firebreaks around farms.
sw: Fyeka nyasi kavu kuzunguka nyumba, mashamba na maghala ya nafaka.
Tengeneza njia za kuzuia moto kuzunguka mashamba.

impact.en: Smoke reducing visibility on some roads
impact.sw: Moshi kupunguza uwezo wa kuona katika baadhi ya barabara

en: Drive slowly with headlights on.
Do not stop in smoke.
sw: Endesha taratibu ukiwasha taa za mbele.
Usisimame ndani ya moshi.

impact.en: Risk to grazing livestock
impact.sw: Hatari kwa mifugo inayochungwa

en: Keep livestock away from burning areas.
Herders: do not set fires to renew pasture.
sw: Weka mifugo mbali na maeneo yanayoungua.
Wafugaji: msiwashe moto kwa ajili ya kuotesha malisho.

impact.en: Higher risk for people with special needs and communities at forest edges
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watu wenye mahitaji maalum na jamii zilizo pembezoni mwa misitu

en: Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review contingency plans, update the list of people with special needs and organise community fire volunteers with tools.
Share this advisory with neighbours, especially older persons, people with disabilities and pregnant women.
sw: Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura, boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum na andaeni vikundi vya kujitolea vya kuzima moto vyenye vifaa.
Wapatie taarifa hii majirani, hasa wazee, watu wenye ulemavu na wajawazito.

impact.en: Fires started by honey gathering near forests
impact.sw: Moto kuanzishwa na urinaji wa asali karibu na misitu

en: Honey gatherers: put out smoking devices completely before leaving.
Do not light fires in forest reserves.
sw: Warinaji wa asali: zimeni kabisa vifaa vya kufukiza moshi kabla ya kuondoka.
Usiwashe moto ndani ya hifadhi za misitu.

impact.en: Risk to rangers, porters and workers in protected areas
impact.sw: Hatari kwa askari wanyamapori, wapagazi na wafanyakazi katika maeneo ya hifadhi

en: Carry water and tools for putting out fires.
Report fires immediately to TANAPA, TAWA or TFS.
sw: Beba maji na vifaa vya kuzima moto.
Toa taarifa ya moto mara moja kwa TANAPA, TAWA au TFS.

impact.en: Need for fire response readiness
impact.sw: Uhitaji wa utayari wa kukabili moto

en: Fire and Rescue Force, TFS and TANAPA: check equipment, firebreaks and water points.
Village/Mtaa leaders: prepare water, sand and firefighting tools.
sw: Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji, TFS na TANAPA: kagueni vifaa, njia za kuzuia moto na vituo vya maji.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: andaeni maji, mchanga na vifaa vya kuzima moto.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Widespread fires in bush and forest areas
impact.sw: Mioto iliyoenea kwenye vichaka na misitu

en: Households near the fire: please move to a safe place now.
Move away from the fire to the side, not uphill and not in the direction the wind is blowing.
District and Ward Disaster Management Committees: meet, activate contingency plans with the Fire and Rescue Force and alert communities by radio, loudspeaker and door-to-door.
sw: Kaya zilizo karibu na moto: tafadhali hamieni mahali salama sasa.
Ondoka mbali na moto kwa kwenda pembeni, si kupanda mlima wala kufuata upande upepo unakoelekea.

Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Wilaya na Kata: kutaneni, amilisheni mipango ya dharura pamoja na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji na toeni tahadhari kwa jamii kupitia redio, vipaza sauti na nyumba kwa nyumba.

impact.en: Threat to homes, farms and buildings near the fire
impact.sw: Hatari kwa nyumba, mashamba na majengo yaliyo karibu na moto

en: Clear dry grass and leaves around buildings.
Keep water, sand and tools ready.
Move documents and valuables to a safe place.
sw: Fyeka nyasi kavu na ondoa majani kuzunguka majengo.
Weka tayari maji, mchanga na vifaa.
Hamishia nyaraka na vitu vya thamani mahali salama.

impact.en: Heavy smoke affecting many communities
impact.sw: Moshi mzito kuathiri jamii nyingi

en: Stay indoors with doors and windows closed.
Keep children indoors.
Go to a health facility if breathing becomes difficult.
sw: Kaa ndani na funga milango na madirisha.
Waweke watoto ndani.
Nenda kituo cha afya ukipata shida ya kupumua.

impact.en: Damage to crops and stored harvests
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa mazao na mavuno yaliyohifadhiwa

en: Harvest mature crops where it is safe.
Move stored grain away from the fire.
Report damage to extension officers.
sw: Vuna mazao yaliyokomaa pale ambapo ni salama.
Hamisha nafaka zilizohifadhiwa mbali na moto.
Toa taarifa ya uharibifu kwa maafisa ugani.

impact.en: Power cuts from fire damage to lines and poles
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme kutokana na moto kuharibu nyaya na nguzo

en: Keep away from burning or fallen power lines.
Report damaged lines to TANESCO.
Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio.
sw: Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zinazoungua au zilizoanguka.
Toa taarifa ya nyaya zilizoharibika kwa TANESCO.
Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri.

impact.en: Roads closed by smoke and active fires
impact.sw: Barabara kufungwa kutokana na moshi na moto unaowaka

en: Do not drive through smoke or burning areas.
Follow instructions from the Traffic Police.
sw: Usiendeshe gari kupita kwenye moshi au maeneo yanayoungua.
Fuata maelekezo ya Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani.

impact.en: Livestock at risk and wild animals fleeing protected areas
impact.sw: Mifugo kuwa hatarini na wanyamapori kukimbia kutoka maeneo ya hifadhi

en: Move livestock away from the fire.
Do not approach wild animals.
Report wild animals near homes to TAWA or TANAPA.
sw: Hamisha mifugo mbali na moto.
Usiwakaribie wanyamapori.
Toa taarifa ya wanyamapori walio karibu na makazi kwa TAWA au TANAPA.

impact.en: Risk to firefighters and volunteers
impact.sw: Hatari kwa wazima moto na wanaojitolea

en: Only trained teams should fight large fires.
Volunteers: work only under the direction of fire teams.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead firefighting with TFS, TANAPA, TAWA and the Police Force.
sw: Timu zilizofunzwa pekee ndizo zizime mioto mikubwa.
Wanaojitolea: fanyeni kazi chini ya maelekezo ya timu za zimamoto pekee.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni uzimaji moto kwa kushirikiana na TFS, TANAPA, TAWA na Jeshi la Polisi.

impact.en: Disruption to mountain climbing and safaris in national parks
impact.sw: Kuathirika kwa upandaji milima na utalii katika hifadhi za taifa

en: Park authorities: suspend climbing and safaris in affected areas.
Tour operators: move guests away from threatened camps and routes.
sw: Mamlaka za hifadhi: sitisheni upandaji milima na safari za utalii katika maeneo yaliyoathirika.
Waendeshaji wa utalii: hamisheni wageni kutoka kambi na njia zilizo hatarini.

impact.en: Damage to mobile towers near forests
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa minara ya simu iliyo karibu na misitu

en: Charge phones and keep a battery-powered radio.
Agree a family meeting point.
sw: Chaji simu na uwe na redio inayotumia betri.
Kubalianeni mahali pa kukutana kama familia.

impact.en: Heavy smoke disrupting schools
impact.sw: Moshi mzito kuathiri shule

en: School heads: keep pupils indoors during heavy smoke.
Follow directives from the District Education Office.
Parents: keep children away from burning areas.
sw: Wakuu wa shule: bakisheni wanafunzi ndani wakati wa moshi mzito.
Fuateni maelekezo ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.
Wazazi: waweke watoto mbali na maeneo yanayoungua.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Severe fires threatening villages, towns, forests and protected areas
impact.sw: Mioto mikubwa inayotishia vijiji, miji, misitu na maeneo ya hifadhi

en: Please evacuate immediately when directed.
Leave early; do not wait until the fire is close.
Please do not go back for belongings.
sw: Tafadhali hama mara moja unapoelekezwa.
Ondoka mapema; usisubiri moto ukaribie.
Tafadhali usirudi kufuata mali.

impact.en: Deaths and injuries from burns and smoke
impact.sw: Vifo na majeruhi kutokana na kuungua na moshi

en: Call 114 or 190.
Cool burns with clean water and take the injured to a health facility.
Health facilities: prepare for burns and breathing emergencies and refer serious cases to regional hospitals.
sw: Piga 114 au 190.
Poza majeraha ya moto kwa maji safi na wapeleke majeruhi kituo cha afya.
Vituo vya afya: jiandaeni kwa majeraha ya moto na matatizo ya kupumua na wapelekeni wagonjwa mahututi hospitali za mkoa.

impact.en: Large-scale evacuation of communities
impact.sw: Uhamishaji mkubwa wa jamii

en: Register at the shelter.
Help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities first.
District Committees: provide food, water, sanitation and protection in shelters.
sw: Jisajili kwenye makazi ya muda.
Wasaidie wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kwanza.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni chakula, maji, huduma za usafi na ulinzi katika makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Major loss of crops, livestock and food stores
impact.sw: Upotevu mkubwa wa mazao, mifugo na akiba ya chakula

en: Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders.
District Committees: provide emergency food assistance.
Extension officers: assess crop and livestock losses.
sw: Toa taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa dharura wa chakula.
Maafisa ugani: fanyeni tathmini ya hasara ya mazao na mifugo.

impact.en: Severe smoke over large areas, including distant towns
impact.sw: Moshi mzito katika maeneo makubwa, ikiwemo miji ya mbali

en: Stay indoors and limit outdoor activity.
Suspend outdoor sports and gatherings.
Go to a health facility if breathing becomes difficult.
sw: Kaa ndani na punguza shughuli za nje.
Sitisha michezo na mikusanyiko ya nje.
Nenda kituo cha afya ukipata shida ya kupumua.

impact.en: Major destruction of forest reserves and water catchments
impact.sw: Uharibifu mkubwa wa hifadhi za misitu na vyanzo vya maji

en: Keep out of burning forests.
Fire and Rescue Force, TFS, TANAPA and TAWA: protect villages at forest edges and water catchments.
sw: Usiingie kwenye misitu inayoungua.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji, TFS, TANAPA na TAWA: lindeni vijiji vilivyo pembezoni mwa misitu na vyanzo vya maji.

impact.en: Tourism operations threatened in national parks and on Mount Kilimanjaro
impact.sw: Shughuli za utalii kuwa hatarini katika hifadhi za taifa na Mlima Kilimanjaro

en: Park authorities: suspend all tourism in affected areas until declared safe.
Tour operators: account for all guests, porters and guides.
sw: Mamlaka za hifadhi: sitisheni utalii wote katika maeneo yaliyoathirika hadi yatangazwe kuwa salama.
Waendeshaji wa utalii: hakikisheni wageni, wapagazi na waongoza watalii wote wanajulikana walipo.

impact.en: Power and communication networks damaged
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa mitandao ya umeme na mawasiliano

en: Listen to official radio broadcasts.
Keep away from fallen power lines.
District Committees: use radio and messengers to reach cut-off villages.
sw: Sikiliza matangazo rasmi ya redio.
Kaa mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka.
Kamati za Wilaya: tumieni redio na wajumbe kufikia vijiji visivyofikika.

impact.en: Health emergencies: burns, breathing problems and trauma
impact.sw: Dharura za kiafya: majeraha ya moto, matatizo ya kupumua na mshtuko

en: Health authorities: send mobile health teams to shelters.
District Committees: provide psychosocial support to survivors and families.
sw: Mamlaka za afya: pelekeni timu za huduma za afya za mkoba kwenye makazi ya muda.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa manusura na familia.

impact.en: Fires restarting from smouldering ground
impact.sw: Moto kuwaka upya kutoka ardhi inayofuka

en: Please return only when the authorities declare the area safe.
Report smoke rising from burnt ground.
Keep livestock out of burnt areas.
sw: Tafadhali rudini pale tu mamlaka zitakapotangaza kuwa eneo ni salama.
Toa taarifa ya moshi unaofuka kutoka ardhi iliyoungua.
Usiingize mifugo kwenye maeneo yaliyoungua.

impact.en: National support required, including JWTZ and aerial firefighting
impact.sw: Msaada wa kitaifa unahitajika, ikiwemo JWTZ na uzimaji moto kwa ndege

en: Regional Committees: request JWTZ and aerial firefighting support through the Prime Minister's Office.
Follow directives from Disaster Management Committees and the Fire and Rescue Force.
sw: Kamati za Mikoa: ombeni msaada wa JWTZ na uzimaji moto kwa ndege kupitia Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu.
Fuata maelekezo ya Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please stay with official sources: radio, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
